eva_ml: Heads-up: onboarding orbis-30b (int4) on canary. With batching > 2 we're seeing intermittent OOMs and a few large tail latencies (p99 spikes). Repro locally with seq_len=1024 and max_new_tokens=512.
sam_runtime: :eyes: Can you paste the error snippet and the exact batching config used on canary?
eva_ml: Here's the relevant log excerpt from the canary pod:
```
[2026-03-18T15:12:03Z] ERROR gpu0: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory
[2026-03-18T15:12:03Z] Context: alloc KV cache slots for batch 3 (seq 1024 -> alloc 3.9 GB)
[2026-03-18T15:12:03Z] Free memory before alloc: 0.45 GB
[2026-03-18T15:12:03Z] Falling back to OOM path, abort generation for request id=xx-yy
```
Batching config on canary:
```
max_batch: 8
batch_timeout_ms: 12
batch_padding: full  # pads to max seq in batch
prefetch_kv: true
warmup_slots: 0
```
liam_oncall: That log looks like padding + KV growth. If you have 8 requests where one has seq 1024 they all pad to that max — KV cache balloons. Prefetch + full padding is a risky combo for tall sequences.
zara_eval: Also noted: when we manually lower max_new_tokens to 256 we avoid some memory work, but evals showed a small quality delta on a handful of our benchmarks (story completion coherence). We'll need a regression check if we change defaults.
sam_runtime: Quick mitigations to try (suggested):
- reduce max_batch to 2 or 4 for seq-heavy routes
- switch batch_padding: dynamic (pad per microbatch) or pad_to_quantum (e.g., 16)
- disable prefetch_kv for this model on canary
- enable kv_eviction_threshold: 0.6 (trim cold KV entries after pressure)
- add slowstart warmup: warmup_slots: 1, ramp to full over 20s
Config patch snippet to test:
```
routes:
  - model: orbis-30b-int4
    max_batch: 4
    batch_padding: dynamic
    batch_token_limit: 8192
    prefetch_kv: false
    kv_eviction_threshold: 0.6
    warmup_slots: 1
    slowstart_seconds: 20
```
eva_ml: I'll flip prefetch off and set max_batch=4 + dynamic padding on canary now. Also will run the eval suite comparing max_new_tokens 512 vs 256 to quantify quality shift.
ci-bot: Triggered deploy: canary/orbis-30b-int4 -> config:v2026-03-18-evict-test by eva_ml (CI job #7821). Logs streaming: https://ci.internal/redwood/logs/7821
liam_oncall: FYI if OOMs persist, try trimming KV more aggressively (kv_trim_after: 0.5) and reduce batch_token_limit. Also confirm kernel selection isn't forcing large temporary buffers for aten ops.
zara_eval: Ran a quick sweep (20 eval prompts) with max_new_tokens=256 vs 512: ROUGE and length metrics show subtle changes; quality regression is small but noticeable on long-context creative tasks. I'll run full eval overnight.
eva_ml: Update: after change (prefetch_kv=false, max_batch=4, dynamic padding) we've been running 2 hours: no OOMs, p99 latency reduced ~200ms on heavy sequences, overall p95 latency down ~15%. Will let the overnight evals finish before proposing rollout.
sam_runtime: Nice. If overnight evals are OK, we should codify these defaults for orbis-30b-int4 (per-model overrides) rather than global defaults. Also add a monitor alert for KV growth (delta > 1GB per 1min) so we catch regressions early.
eva_ml: Agreed. Next steps: 1) finalize evals 2) create PR for per-model config + alert 3) schedule gradual rollout. Thanks all :rocket:
ci-bot: Eval job started: eval/orbis-30b-int4/compare-maxnew-512-vs-256 (#9834). Results will post to /eng-ml channel when done.
(End of thread)
